<div class="card-body">
'''Cantina Brawl''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">カンティーナの乱闘</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、カンティーナで乱闘を起こす。両プレイヤーとも、運命数を引く。どちらかの運命数と同じ能力値を持つキャラクターは、失われる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-73o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「気を付けろよ。少々荒っぽい場所だからな…。」モス・アイズリーのカンティーナでは、密輸屋、盗賊、強盗、お尋ね者、傭兵にバウンティ・ハンターと何でも揃える。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Cantina Brawl.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to cause a brawl in the Cantina. Both players draw destiny. Characters with ability matching either destiny are lost.

'''Lore:''' “Watch yourself. This place can be a little rough…” Mos Eisley’s Cantina has smugglers, thieves, robbers, wanted men, mercenaries and bounty hunters.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Cantina Brawl]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
